Predage Community

Predage Community is the main server for everyone who's part of Predage's world. It's a place to hang out, chat about the streams, share memes, jump into voice calls, and just be around people who get it. Whether you're here to talk, joke around, join in on events, or just see what's going on, there's a spot for you here. New members are always welcome, so come say hi and make yourself at home.

PredCord
Join Discord

PredCord was created to give Predage's community the best practice experience possible. It's run by the main moderators, and it's where the customs get hosted, Reload, Battle Royale, all built around the current competitive format. If you're looking to sharpen your gameplay and scrim with people who take it seriously, this is the place to be.
